v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dele iniquitátem meam, * Dómine, secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

text.la: Discérne causam meam, * Deus, de gente non sancta.
text.en: Distinguish my cause, O Lord, * from the nation that is not holy.

text.la: Deus misereátur * nostri, et benedícat nobis. ‡
text.en: May God have mercy on us * and bless us. ‡

text.la: Corrípies me, Dómine, * et vivificábis me.
text.en: Thou shalt correct me, O Lord, * and make me to live.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quia benígnus est, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for he will judge his people, and be gracious unto his servants.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Eréxit nobis * Dóminus cornu salútis in domo David púeri sui.
text.en: The Lord has raised up * a horn of salvation for us in the house of David his servant.

text.la: Preces nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: atque, a peccatórum vínculis absolútos, ab omni nos adversitáte custódi.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech You, mercifully hear our prayers; loose us from the chains of our sins and keep us from all adversity.
